map.基于 Web Audio 的实验性听觉测试。包含「间隙检测」（两段白噪声间插入可: An experimental Web Audio hearing test. It includes two paradigms: gap detection, where an adjustable gap is inserted between two bursts of white noise and you judge whether you can hear the break, and modulation detection, where amplitude modulation is added to a carrier and you judge whether you can hear the fluctuation. A 2-IFC adaptive staircase estimates millisecond-level thresholds, which are then compared with reference ranges for children, young adults and older adults. Please test in a quiet environment wearing headphones.

map.听觉时间分辨率指听觉系统分辨快速时间结构变化的能力。间隙检测（Gap Detec: Auditory temporal resolution is the ability of the auditory system to resolve rapid changes in temporal structure. The gap detection threshold (GDT) reflects the ability to notice brief silence, while amplitude modulation detection (AMD) reflects the ability to track loudness fluctuation. Both decline with age and relate to central auditory processing. This page uses a 2-IFC adaptive staircase, shrinking the stimulus after each correct answer and enlarging it after each wrong one, and takes the mean of the reversals in the final segment as an approximate estimate.

map.间隙检测与调制检测有什么区别？: What is the difference between gap detection and modulation detection?
map.间隙检测判断两段噪声之间能否听出静默间断；调制检测判断纯音响度是否周期起伏，二者: Gap detection judges whether a silent break can be heard between two noise bursts, while modulation detection judges whether a pure tone fluctuates periodically in loudness; together they reflect temporal resolution ability.
